query.description: Specify the reference query to retrieve the count of Gencore files.

request.description:
## Request body parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `response_config` | object | Specify configuration options for handling the API response. | — |
| `response_config.int_64_to_str` | boolean | Type true to allow conversion of int64 to string. | `true` |
| `response_config.format` | integer | Specify the value of format 0 or 1. We recommend using 1. | `1` |
| `skip_cache` | boolean | Type true to skip cache and false not to. | `true` |
| `source` | string | source for gencore pipelines list | `gencore_doc_metadata` |
| `fields` | array | Specify the value of fields. | — |
| `fields[].name` | string | Specify the field name. | `resource_id` |
| `fields[].type` | string | Specify the field type. | `aggregate` |
| `fields[].options` | object | Specify additional options for the field. | — |
| `fields[].options.function` | string | Specify the aggregation function applied to the field. | `count` |
| `fields[].options.alias` | string | Specify the alias name for the aggregated field. | `docs_count` |
| `group_by` | array | Specify the fields used to group the results. | — |
| `group_by[].field` | string | Specify the field name used for grouping the results. | `pipeline_id` |
| `filter` | object | Specify the values to fetch files count. | — |
| `filter.op` | string | Specify the logical operator to combine multiple filter conditions. | `and` |
| `filter.value` | array | Specify the list of filter conditions to be applied. | — |
| `filter.value[].field` | string | Specify the field on which the filter is applied. | `pipeline_id` |
| `filter.value[].op` | string | Specify the logical operator to combine multiple filter conditions. | `eq` |
| `filter.value[].value` | string | Specify the value used for comparison in the filter condition. | `xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx` |

## Request body parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[]` | array | List of data system IDs to fetch data sources for. | — |
| `[]` (item) | string | A unique data system ID. | `xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx` |

query.description: Specify the reference query used to retrieve Gencore scan details.

request.description:
## Request body parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `response_config` | object | Specify configuration options for handling the API response. | — |
| `response_config.int_64_to_str` | boolean | Specify if int64 values must be converted to strings in the response. | `true` |

| `fields` | array | Specify the value of fields. | — |
| `fields[].name` | string | Specify the field name to retrieve. | `scan_name` |
| `filter` | object | Specify the values to fetch Gencore AI scans. | — |
| `filter.op` | string | Specify the logical operator to combine multiple filter conditions. | `and` |
| `filter.value` | array | Specify the list of filter conditions to be applied. | — |
| `filter.value[].field` | string | Specify the field on which the filter is applied. | `gencore_pipeline_id` |
| `filter.value[].op` | string | Specify the logical operator to combine multiple filter conditions. | `eq` |
| `filter.value[].value` | string | Specify the value for the pipeline ID. | `xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx` |
| `pagination` | object | Specify pagination parameters to control data retrieval. | — |
| `order_by` | array | Define parameter to order scans by. | — |

## Request body parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `response_config` | object | Specify configuration options for handling the API response. | — |
| `response_config.format` | integer | Specify the format to be applied to the response. | `1` |
| `skip_cache` | boolean | Specify if the cache must be bypassed and fetch fresh data. | `true` |
| `source` | string | Specify the data source to query. | `gencore_provider_configuration_list` |
| `fields` | array | Specify the list of fields to retrieve in the response. | — |
| `fields[].name` | string | Specify the field name. | `id` |
| `fields[].type` | string | Specify the type of field transformation. | `function` |
| `fields[].options` | object | Specify additional options for the field transformation. | — |
| `fields[].options.alias` | string | Specify the alias name for the field. | `id` |
| `fields[].options.function` | string | Specify the function applied to the field. | `convert_text` |
| `order_by` | array | Specify the fields used to order the results. | `["-created_at"]` |
| `order_by[]` | string | Specify the field used for sorting the results. | `-created_at` |
| `filter` | object | Specify the values to fetch list of providers. | — |
| `filter.op` | string | Specify the logical operator to combine multiple filter conditions. | `and` |
| `filter.value` | array | Specify the list of filter conditions to be applied. | — |
| `filter.value[].op` | string | Specify the logical operator to combine multiple filter conditions. | `eq` |
| `filter.value[].field` | string | Specify the field on which the filter is applied. | `type` |
| `filter.value[].value` | string | Specify the value for the field. | `llm` |
| `pagination` | object | Specify pagination parameters to control data retrieval. | — |
| `pagination.type` | string | Specify pagination type to be used. | `limit-offset` |
| `pagination.offset` | integer | Specify the number of records to skip before returning results. | `0` |
| `pagination.limit` | integer | Specify maximum number of records to return. | `10` |
| `pagination.page` | integer | Specify which page of results to retrieve. | `1` |

## Request body parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | boolean | Specify the status of the instance. | `true` |
| `name` | string | Specify the instance name. | `instance-name` |
| `provider` | string | Specify the provider name. | `providername` |
| `type` | string | Specify the model provider type. | `llm` |
| `models` | array | Specify the list of configured models. | — |
| `models[].name` | string | Specify the model name. | `text-embedding-3-large` |
| `models[].model_type` | string | Specify the model type. | `embedding_indexer` |
| `models[].config` | object | Specify configuration details for the model. | — |
| `models[].config.deployment_name` | string | Specify the deployment name for the model. |  |
